rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for a person's death.

example.english: His sudden demise yesterday left everyone heartbroken.
example.traditional: 佢噚日突然死咗，大家都好傷心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cam4 jat6 dat6 jin4 sei2 zo2 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 soeng1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for the downfall or collapse of a government, organization, or other established entity.

example.english: The demise of this corrupt government was truly satisfying.
example.traditional: 呢個貪污政府嘅垮台，真係大快人心。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 taam1 wu1 zing3 fu2 ge3 kwaa1 toi1 zan1 hai6 daai6 faai3 jan4 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on a project or venture coming to an unsuccessful end rather than an institution collapsing.

example.english: The demise of this unfinished project was a relief to the neighbours.
example.traditional: 呢個爛尾工程嘅結束，令街坊鬆一口氣。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 laan6 mei5 gung1 cing4 ge3 git3 cuk1 ling6 gaai1 fong1 sung1 jat1 hau2 hei3
